svg.text: FlashAttention — sweep the tiled score grid, carry (m, ℓ, O), never materialize S

g.text: Partition: Q → 2 row-tiles · K,V → 2 col-tiles. All 4 S-blocks: not yet computed.
Outer i=1: Q1 crosses THE LINK into SRAM — loaded once for the whole row.
Carry starts empty: m=−∞ · ℓ=0 · O=0 — one tile of state serves the whole row.
Inner j=1: K1,V1 stream across THE LINK — only THIS pair is ever resident.
S11 = Q1·K1ᵀ = [[2,0],[1,1]] — computed in registers, never leaves the chip.
First tile of the row: m ← [2, 1].
α = e^(m−m′) = 1 — first tile: nothing carried yet, nothing to rebase.
Local weights P̃ = e^(S−m′) against the current max.
O = α·O + P̃·V1 → block S11 folded into the carry.
Inner j=2: K1,V1 evicted the instant K2,V2 arrive — still ONE resident pair.
S12 = Q1·K2ᵀ = [[2,4],[2,2]] — computed in registers, never leaves the chip.
m: rows re-maxed → [4, 2] — the carried ℓ,O were measured against the OLD m.
THE REBASE: α = [0.14, 0.37] — ONE multiply re-references the whole carry.
Local weights P̃ = e^(S−m′) against the current max.
O = α·O + P̃·V2 → block S12 folded into the carry.
O1 rides THE LINK back to HBM — the only write-back this row makes.
OUTER LOOP ADVANCES: carry RESETS to (−∞,0,0), Q2 loads, cursor jumps to S21.
Inner j=1: K1,V1 stream across THE LINK — only THIS pair is ever resident.
S21 = Q2·K1ᵀ = [[0,2],[1,0]] — computed in registers, never leaves the chip.
First tile of the row: m ← [2, 1].
α = e^(m−m′) = 1 — first tile: nothing carried yet, nothing to rebase.
Local weights P̃ = e^(S−m′) against the current max.
O = α·O + P̃·V1 → block S21 folded into the carry.
Inner j=2: K1,V1 evicted the instant K2,V2 arrive — still ONE resident pair.
S22 = Q2·K2ᵀ = [[2,0],[1,2]] — computed in registers, never leaves the chip.
m: rows re-maxed → [2, 2] — the carried ℓ,O were measured against the OLD m.
THE REBASE: α = [1, 0.37] — ONE multiply re-references the whole carry.
Local weights P̃ = e^(S−m′) against the current max.
O = α·O + P̃·V2 → block S22 folded into the carry.
O2 rides THE LINK to HBM. Every block swept — S existed only one tile at a time.
O = softmax(QKᵀ)·V exactly — and the n×n score matrix never existed off-chip.

svg.text: computing now (gold ring = the one change firing)
folded into the carry (done) · matrix divider line = tile boundary
INVARIANT: after every folded tile, O/ℓ = exact softmax over the keys seen so far.
PAYOFF: naive ships the n×n score matrix across THE LINK — O(n²) traffic;
FlashAttention ships tiles + one carry — O(n). Same output, bit-for-bit.
d=2, N=4, Br=Bc=2 ⇒ Tr=Tc=2 grid · values rounded to 2 dp · animation loops
THE LINK — every byte crosses here
Naive writes ALL of S (N×N) here — FlashAttention writes only O.
NOT to scale: HBM ≈ 2·10⁵ × SRAM (A100: 40 GB vs 192 KB/SM).
